title: Movement Building Manager
summary: Kaleidoscope Trust, which campaigns for LGBT+ human rights internationally, is hiring a Movement Building Manager on a fixed-term maternity-cover contract.
open_to: Open application; role is fully remote within the UK, with occasional travel
evidence: Page states: "Closing Date: Sunday 13th September 2026 at 23:59 (London time)." and "£43,000 p.a. plus pension contributions", "Fixed-term maternity cover (up to 12 months)." Read 28 Aug 2026 at https://kaleidoscopetrust.com/kaleidoscope-trust-is-hiring-movement-building-manager/

title: Indigo Counsellor
summary: LGBT Foundation is recruiting counsellors for Indigo, its NHS-commissioned gender service for trans and non-binary people in Greater Manchester.
open_to: Lived experience of trans/non-binary identity valued; applications from people of colour encouraged
evidence: Page states: "Closing Date: 11th September at 9 am", "£31,261.36 pro rata per annum", and actively encourages applications from "people of colour, racially minoritized communities, trans/non-binary individuals, and people aged 50+." Read 28 Aug 2026 at https://lgbt.foundation/vacancy/indigo-counsellor-august-2026/

title: Write For Us — open submissions for racially-minoritised writers and illustrators
summary: Storymix, a children's and YA book packager, takes rolling open submissions of sample work from racially-minoritised writers and illustrators at any career stage.
open_to: Racially-minoritised writers and illustrators, new or experienced; agents may submit for clients
evidence: Page states Storymix is "seeking to collaborate with racially-minoritized writers and illustrators", welcoming "new writer or illustrator seeking to develop your craft" through an open Submittable form, no deadline given. Read 28 Aug 2026 at https://www.storymix.co.uk/write-for-us

title: National Lottery Project Grants
summary: Arts Council England's open-access fund for individual artists and practitioners, and community and cultural organisations, with no fixed application deadline.
open_to: Individual artists/practitioners and community or cultural organisations in England
evidence: Page states: "Project Grants is always open for applications between £1,000 and £100,000" and that it "supports thousands of individual practitioners, community and cultural organisations." Read 28 Aug 2026 at https://www.artscouncil.org.uk/ProjectGrants

title: Authors' Foundation grants for work-in-progress
summary: Rolling grants, usually £2,000–£3,000, for published or commercially-commissioned authors, translators and scriptwriters who need funds for research, travel or living costs on a current project.
open_to: UK/Irish-published or commissioned authors, translators, scriptwriters; no deadline
evidence: Page states: "There are no deadlines for this fund as it accepts submissions on a rolling basis" and "Grants are usually between £2,000-£3,000." Read 28 Aug 2026 at https://societyofauthors.org/grants/authors-foundation/

title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
summary: Research funding for projects affiliated with a UK organisation, particularly welcoming applicants from racially minoritised communities and partnerships between researchers and those communities.
open_to: Affiliated with a UK-based org; particularly racially minoritised applicants/communities
evidence: Page states: "Outline application deadline: 5 October 2026", "Grants from £15,000 to £500,000 are available", and it "particularly encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly from individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities." Read 28 Aug 2026 at https://www.nuffieldfoundation.org/funding-for-research/racial-diversity-uk-fund

title: Churchill Fellowship 2027
summary: A funded 4–8 week overseas fact-finding trip, averaging over £6,000, for UK citizens to learn from practice elsewhere and bring it back to their community, trade or profession.
open_to: UK citizen/passport holder, resident in UK, aged 18+; no formal qualifications needed
evidence: Page states: "Applications open on Tuesday 1 September 2026 at 9.30am" and "Applications close on Tuesday 20 October 2026 at midday." Eligibility per FAQ page: "UK Citizen holding a UK passport, resident in the UK, and aged 18 or over." CAVEAT: window opens 1 Sept 2026, a few days after this research (28 Aug); deadline is well past the 8 Sep cutoff. Read 28 Aug 2026.

title: Archival Support, Library Assistance and Communications volunteering
summary: Black Cultural Archives, the home of Black British history in Brixton, is seeking ongoing volunteers for archival support, library assistance and communications work.
evidence: Page states eligibility "individuals over the age of 18 from all backgrounds" for three unpaid roles (Archival Support, Library Assistance, Communications), rolling, apply via archives@bcaheritage.org.uk. Read 28 Aug 2026 at https://blackculturalarchives.org/opportunities

title: Management Board Member (Trustee)
summary: ELOP, an LGBTQ+-led mental health and wellbeing charity in east London, is recruiting unpaid trustees to join its governing Management Board.
open_to: General public; welcomes LGBTQ+ applicants with an interest in mental health governance
evidence: CharityJob listing for ELOP shows the role "Management Board", unpaid, Walthamstow/Greater London, closing date "30 October 2026". Read 28 Aug 2026 at https://www.charityjob.co.uk/organisation/elop

title: British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants — independent scholar round
summary: Grants of up to £10,000 for humanities and social science research, open to independent scholars as well as those affiliated with a UK institution.
open_to: Postdoctoral (or equivalent) researchers ordinarily resident in the UK, incl. independent scholars
evidence: Page states: "The independent scholar deadline for this round is 28 October 2026 (17:00 GMT)", "Scheme opens date: 2 Sep 2026", award "Up to £10,000". CAVEAT: round opens 2 Sept 2026, a few days after this research (28 Aug); deadline is well past the 8 Sep cutoff. Read 28 Aug 2026.
